summary: BrainsWay Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that presents clinical data from a study on its SWIFT accelerated Deep TMS protocol for Major Depressive Disorder. The filing reports an over 80% remission rate at 12 months based on a prospective, randomized controlled trial. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine disclosure of scientific results from a medical device company and does not trigger any special-situations category.
